assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a text-free observation picture for a grade 6 AlloFlow decision lesson. Create one polished landscape editorial illustration, softly textured gouache with crisp readable shapes, mature enough for ages 11–13. Show a fictional small school reading corner from an elevated three-quarter view: low wooden bookshelves along two walls, plain books, one large fixed rectangular table positioned so close across the front of one bookshelf that its lower shelves cannot be approached easily. Clearly show the obstructed shelf access as a design problem to investigate. A clear open area remains in the foreground. The table is fixed-legged, not on wheels. The room is empty of people. Simple natural cream walls, teal and warm ochre accents, realistic furniture proportions, restrained detail and gentle even lighting. This is a proposed trial layout, not an approved accessible design. Do NOT add a proposed solution, new furniture, measurements, arrows, hazard symbols, floor markings, labels, letters, numbers, logos, text, watermarks, or decorative border. The illustration is qualitative and not a measured plan. Landscape 3:2 composition.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: text-free five-choice equipment picture for a grade 6 reading-space decision lesson. One polished landscape editorial gouache illustration with crisp, clear object silhouettes and restrained paper texture. On a plain warm off-white background show exactly FIVE clearly separated equipment groups at similar visual weight with plenty of space: upper left a simple freestanding teal divider screen on two stable feet; upper right a small warm-ochre task lamp; center a compact wooden movable rectangular table with four legs and four visible caster wheels; lower left a single woven book basket holding a few plain unlettered books; lower right one stack of three square fabric seat pads in muted teal and ochre. All five objects recognizable and fully within frame. Consistent believable three-quarter perspective and gentle natural shadows. This is an equipment menu, not a room layout and not a recommendation of which items to buy. No people, token symbols, prices, words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, connectors, logos, watermarks, panels or border. All text and invented prices will be provided separately as accessible editable lesson text. Landscape 3:2 composition.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a fictional student group scene for a grade 6 academic discussion lesson. One polished landscape editorial gouache illustration, restrained paper texture, crisp readable shapes, believable anatomy, a warm cream/teal/ochre school palette, mature and respectful not childish. Four fictional students about 11–13 years old with varied skin tones and hairstyles sit comfortably around a simple classroom worktable. On the table are two sheets with different simple unlabelled room-layout sketches, a few blank evidence cards and pencils. One student indicates a detail on one sheet with a single finger; another holds a pencil near a second sheet; a third has a small tablet angled toward the group with an abstract blank light screen; the fourth is considering the shared papers. Calm ordinary expressions, varied gaze directions, no exaggerated smiles, no requirement that everyone look into one another's eyes. Every student has a plausible position and personal working space. Show consideration of alternative plans without depicting a correct answer or winner. No teacher or evaluator, no competition, no thumbs-up or judgment symbols. No readable text, words, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, labels, logos, watermarks, border or explanatory arrows. Leave the intellectual content for the separate editable dialogue in the lesson; a picture alone does not prove collaboration. Landscape 3:2 composition.
